text: うえの　フロア　から　れんらくが　きてるぜ！

structure.jp: うえの　フロア　から
れんらくが　きてるぜ！

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb can say something has happened and still stands; here it is shortened to てる. きてる = 'has come in'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is a rough, manly way of pushing your point. きてるぜ = 'it's come in, I tell you'.
